name: 281. Aggregate model listing completeness (#8759)
description: Pins issue #8759. The unscoped GET /v1/models fans out to every provider and walks each provider's pages 1,000 rows at a time. The per-provider poll deadline used to cover the whole walk, and every page re-fetches the upstream catalog, so a large catalog timed out after its first page and the aggregate silently kept 1,000 rows with no next_page_token while ?provider=<name> returned everything. The case lists the unscoped aggregate, walks the provider-scoped listing through next_page_token, and asserts every scoped model id is in the aggregate. Hugging Face is the largest catalog in the integration profile; the invariant holds for every provider.
